channel.title: AI Threat Watch: AI exam fraud
channel.description: Verified case files in the category AI exam fraud.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Tanzania's NECTA cancels 58 Form Six results after candidates used phones to access ChatGPT in exams
item.description: Tanzania's National Examinations Council cancelled the results of 58 ACSEE candidates for malpractice, including using mobile phones to access ChatGPT to answer exam questions. The council did not say how many of the cases involved ChatGPT. Target: Tanzania's 2026 Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (ACSEE). TZ. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Dozens of Yonsei University students admit using ChatGPT in an online midterm for a ChatGPT course
item.description: In an online midterm on 15 October 2025 where AI use was banned, students angled webcams or opened other programs to evade proctoring and used ChatGPT and other AI tools. About 40 students admitted cheating and about 10 more were suspected, while an unverified student poll had 211 of 387 respondents saying they cheated. Target: Yonsei University online midterm, Natural Language Processing and ChatGPT course (~600 students). KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Vietnam police open criminal cases after candidates used ChatGPT, Gemini and StudyX in national exam
item.description: In Lam Dong, an 18-year-old candidate streamed the literature paper via a button camera to a 17-year-old helper who used ChatGPT to answer and read it back through an earpiece; in Hanoi, candidates photographed maths and other papers and sent them to StudyX and Gemini. Police opened cases under state-secret disclosure laws and the candidates were disqualified. Target: Vietnam's 2025 national high school graduation exam. VN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Turkish police jail university entrance exam candidate who used a button camera and AI to get answers
item.description: During Turkey's university entrance exam in Isparta, a candidate used a camera disguised as a shirt button, a router hidden in his shoe sole and an earpiece; the camera captured questions and AI software generated answers read back to him. He was detained for acting suspiciously, formally arrested and jailed pending trial, and an accomplice was also detained. Target: Turkey's national university entrance exam (Isparta province). TR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] WAEC withholds WASSCE results for candidates at 235 Ghanaian schools over AI-generated answers
item.description: The West African Examinations Council withheld subject results of candidates from 235 schools in Ghana for collusion and use of AI-generated answers in the 2023 WASSCE. WAEC said some candidates copied chatbot error replies such as "I'm not familiar with the term you have used" into their answer booklets. Target: Ghana's 2023 West African Senior School Certificate Examination. GH. Verification: confirmed.
